bagPolicy.summary: The Pocket hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Free parking is available in front of 7DrumCity after 9:30am on weekdays. More spots are on P St NW and Bates St NW between North Capitol St and 1st St.
parking.quote: Enjoy free parking in front of 7DrumCity (after 9:30am weekdays)

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Pocket. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Pocket's bar serves local craft beverages, cocktails, spirits and wine, plus house-made mocktails, kava and premium sodas.
concessions.quote: The Pocket offers local craft beverages, cocktails, spirits, wines, made-in-house mocktails, kava, and premium sodas (page summary).

accessibility.summary: The Pocket is not wheelchair accessible, but staff are happy to help as needed. The venue's about page links to more detail on the entrance, seating and restroom access.
accessibility.quote: Our space is unfortunately not wheelchair accessible, however, we are happy to assist as needed.

reEntry.summary: The Pocket hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold through Eventbrite and all sales are final. Refunds or exchanges are only issued if a show is canceled or for other valid reasons set by the ticketing partner.

gates.summary: The Pocket is inside 7DrumCity. When you arrive, check in at the front desk, then head up the stairs on your right.
gates.quote: When you arrive, just check in at the front desk
